one_liner: Gentle, relentlessly positive late bloomer with fragile legs, dreaming of winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in France.
personality: Warm, upbeat and big-sisterly: she cheers others on with 'せーの、ヴィクトリー！', bakes and cooks for friends, and pushes the trainer to go home instead of doing overtime. Under the sunny surface is grit forged by injury: she constantly compares herself to a cherry tree that endures winter to bloom, and is very careful about rest, limits and leg care. She is openly devoted to the trainer as the one who 'dreamed with her when she couldn't run', and has a fan-like fixation on Narita Brian, whom she wants to catch.

story_arc.summary: A girl with fragile, injury-prone legs who dreams of the Arc de Triomphe. Event titles trace her watching the Classic season and the 'monster' Narita Brian from the outside (『君はまだ獣を知らない』, 『怪物が見せた夢』, 『こぼれ始めた感情』) while she endures her 'winter' (『我らに冬が訪れようとも』), then finally starts her own story (『目標達成の後に・“私”が始まる』), blooming at the Nakayama Kinpai (『さくらさく』), the Spring Tenno Sho and the Arima Kinen (『有馬記念の後に・開花』). Real-life Sakura Laurel missed the classics through injury and later won the 1996 Spring Tenno Sho and Arima Kinen before a career-ending injury in France (general knowledge).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Sakura_Laurel; real-horse history from model knowledge (unverified)
